multi_entity_note: Case series of two infants (21-month-old girl, 8-month-old boy) plus the first child's father with AVB; first patient taken as the subject.

medical.diagnosis.rationale: First infant had second-degree type II AVB that did not recover and required a pacemaker; the third-degree AVB mentions belong to the father or the second infant.

medical.treatment_drug.rationale: Treatment was pacemaker implantation; no medication is named.
